newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Most Cypriots want British bases to close, poll.
newsitem.headline: Most Cypriots want British bases to close, poll.

text.p: Some 70 per cent of Cypriots believe Britain should close its two military bases on the Mediterranean island, according to an opinion poll published on Friday.

Of the 400 people questioned by Cyprus college researchers for Periodiko magazine 69 per cent said the government should ask Britain to leave the sprawling sovereign bases at Akrotiri and Dhekelia, retained when Cyprus became independent in 1960.
Only 12 per cent of those polled thought the bases were good for Cyprus and 62 per cent said they were bad.
